name: Movement of Life and Death
take: Three-stage Havoc strings where Stage 3 both writes a Volatile Note - Strings onto her staff and drops her into Reincarnate for the Circuit follow-ups. The Heavy hides the real crescendo: with six Notes composed and the Compose timer up, it becomes Scarlet Coda — a 495% detonation that grows another 82% PER Aftersound stack, counts as Resonance Skill DMG and an Echo Skill cast, and flips her into Resolving Chord. The basic string is sheet music. The Coda is the performance.

name: Whispers in a Fleeting Dream
take: A quick double-hit that writes a Volatile Note - Winds and sends her into Reincarnate. Deliberately small on its own — its job is to feed the staff and unlock Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, the enhanced follow-up. Every whisper is another bar of the piece she's been writing since Yuanwu's shop closed.

name: Rhapsody of a New World
take: The composition system. Reincarnate turns her next basic into Movement of Fate and Finality and her next skill into Murmurs in a Haunting Dream — both counted as Resonance Skill DMG, both writing more Notes. Six Volatile Notes fill the staff (Strings, Winds, and Cadenza, each cueing a different Hecate enhanced attack), and Aftersound stacks to 24 — with Octet converting every stack into Crit DMG. She isn't building resources. She's orchestrating them.

name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths
take: Her max Resonance Energy is ZERO — the ult costs nothing and answers only to Resolving Chord, earned by performing Scarlet Coda. Then 24s of Maestro: +120% ATK, and Hecate rises to fight — sharing her stats, her damage credited to her, playing the six Notes in turn. Off-field, Hecate answers every team Echo Skill cast with an enhanced attack, up to ten per waltz. Curtain Call ends it at 465%. The dead girl conducts; the phantom performs; the audience does not get an intermission.

name: Suite of Quietus
take: A swap-in strike that chains straight into Basic Stage 3 — the note-writing stage. In Maestro it becomes Suite of Immortality instead: a 596% Resonance Skill entrance that Stagnates the target. Quietus when she's composing, Immortality when the orchestra is already playing. The titles are not subtle and neither is she.

name: Unfinished Piece
take: Hands the incoming Resonator 20% Havoc DMG Amplification and 25% Heavy Attack Amplification for 14s — and if she leaves mid-Maestro, Hecate plays two more enhanced attacks on her way out. Amplification, not a bonus: it multiplies at the end of the damage formula, which is why her handoff hits harder than the sheet suggests. The piece stays unfinished on purpose. Some promises are like that.

name: Accidental
take: Echo Skill casts grant interruption resistance and 30% damage reduction for 15s — her armor is literally playing the set. And after her intro or any Echo cast, the next Volatile Note written becomes a Cadenza, the note that cues Hecate's best enhanced attack. In music, an accidental is a note outside the key signature. In her hands it's the one that hits hardest.

name: Octet
take: Ten Aftersound stacks free on entering battle, and every stack pays 2.5% Crit DMG — that's +25% CD just for showing up, +60% at the 24-stack cap. Past the cap, overflow stacks keep paying 1% each up to another +100%. Her crit ceiling isn't on her echoes; it's in how long the performance has been running.
